documentation.content:
**milton-app is failing users.** One email per incident; it closes 30 minutes after the condition clears. The condition name says which signal fired.

Check first:
1. Did a release just move traffic? `gcloud run services describe milton-app --project=milton-510506 --region=us-east4 --format='yaml(status.traffic)'`. If so, roll back per server/deploy/README.md, "Release verification and rollback".
2. Errors: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="milton-app" AND severity>=ERROR' --project=milton-510506 --freshness=1h --limit=50`
3. If errors mention the database: Neon status and endpoint `ep-curly-cherry-b8l7hc8f`.

Thresholds (7-day baseline to 2026-11-08; traffic is about 8 to 25 requests an hour, so counts, not ratios):
- 5xx: 10 or more in a rolling 15 minutes, held 5 minutes. Reason: the 7-day worst for milton-app was 6 in one 15-minute window (a release's 503s, 11-04); one 5xx in five requests would already be a 20% ratio.
- Latency: p95 over a rolling 5 minutes above 5 s, held 30 minutes; no data, no alert. Reason: 40 to 70 times the median 5-minute p95 (116 ms); the 7-day worst was 7.4 s, for 5 minutes. A 30-minute window was rejected: on 11-04 one 7.8 s scanner request to the app held a 30-minute p95 above 5 s for 30 minutes at this traffic. With 5-minute windows, slow requests must recur for half an hour.
- ERROR log entries (metric `milton-errors`): 10 or more in a rolling 15 minutes, held 5 minutes. Reason: the 7-day worst was 6 (the same release). Cloud Run logs each 5xx at ERROR, so a 5xx burst counts here too.
- Instances: more than 8 for 15 minutes. Reason: the 7-day maximum was 3 (one is kept warm); this is a traffic spike, not a failure.

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "milton-app" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"

conditions.displayName: milton-app latency: p95 over 5 min > 5 s, held 30 min
milton-app ERROR logs: ≥ 10 in 15 min, held 5 min
